name: R6.2 Remind the owner and draft a follow-up when a quote goes quiet

nodes.name: Step 1: Quiet-quote check each working day
nodes.notes: Monday to Friday at 7:00, before the trade desk opens. Set the workflow's time zone (Settings), or the run moves at each daylight-saving change.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

nodes.name: Step 2: CRM: List sent quotes
nodes.notes: Each quote with its revision, sent date, valid-until date, owner and last activity (date and accepted summary, from R6.1).

nodes.name: CRM: Read account flags
nodes.notes: The dispute flag, set by hand until R8.3 is built.

nodes.name: CRM: Read reminder tasks
nodes.notes: The reminders this workflow has sent: one task each.

nodes.name: Step 3: Rule: sort by Table 6.2
nodes.notes: The rule decides; only the last row reaches step 6.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 4: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).
